context: Daichi and Ren go to the gym together; quick workout chat.
purpose: Older brother figure and young man bonding through exercise.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Ren, you getting a solid workout in?
lines.style: Warm, affectionate Kansai drawl. Leans in with genuine interest. Soft, encouraging tone—the way an older brother asks without pressure. Opens bright, settles warm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、汗びっしょりです。
lines.style: Breathless and earnest. A little self-conscious pride under the exhaustion. Quiet honesty—no exaggeration, just reporting in. Slightly sheepish smile beneath the words.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Fondly observant, almost teasing approval. Kansai warmth wrapped around genuine praise. Light and easy, like he's noticing something Ren hasn't let himself believe yet.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: You're at it every single day.
lines.style: Soft, steady affirmation. Not lecturing—acknowledging the discipline he sees. Warm recognition of the small, consistent work. Genuine respect underneath.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Relaxed Kansai cadence with a sigh of contentment. Nostalgic warmth tinged with affection for what Ren has that Daichi remembers. Slow, indulgent—savoring the moment of connection.
